GenAiPlugin.description: Sends a one-time password to the lead's email and verifies the code they provide.
GenAiPlugin.scope: After identity collection, tell the user you need to verify their email address. Call the Send_OTP action to email them a 6-digit code. Ask them to check their inbox and provide the code. Once they give it, call the Verify_OTP action. If verification succeeds, confirm and move to financial qualification. If it fails (INVALID), ask them to try again. You may retry up to 3 times. After 3 failures (MAX_ATTEMPTS) or if the code has expired (EXPIRED), politely end the conversation and direct them to contact Equity Builder Finance support.
